position: VedaPath is close to a real private launch rehearsal, but public launch should wait for live retrieval tests, rights, reviewer accounts, and safety review.
headline: Open the private room, keep the public door closed.
copy: This gate gives the founder a clear go/no-go posture: demo the source-first workflow privately, collect feedback carefully, and keep all production promises off.

postures.title: Private demo
postures.copy: Founder-led demo with static sources, clear prototype labels, and no account promises.

postures.title: Public launch
postures.copy: Requires live retrieval, reviewer operations, rights posture, privacy terms, and safety review.

postures.title: Production storage
postures.copy: No server persistence until account, consent, export, deletion, and audit rules exist.

postures.title: Live AI
postures.copy: Can be prototyped only behind source API contract and no-source refusal tests.

flow.title: Show source-first ask
flow.copy: Start with one real question and the source packet.

flow.title: Show adapter boundary
flow.copy: Explain how source packets become bounded answer drafts.

flow.title: Show reviewer receipt
flow.copy: Keep human approval and blocked fields visible.

flow.title: Collect private feedback
flow.copy: Use review tickets, not silent knowledge changes.

decisions.label: Private founder demo
decisions.reason: Static source-first path is coherent enough to show carefully.

decisions.label: Public beta
decisions.reason: Needs real API, rights, reviewer workflow, privacy, and safety checks.

decisions.label: Live AI
decisions.reason: Needs no-source evals and adapter tests first.

decisions.label: Payment
decisions.reason: No pricing, terms, support, or production SLA exists.

locks.title: Rights lock
locks.copy: Do not display licensed translations publicly without permission.

locks.title: Reviewer lock
locks.copy: Do not promote hold records without reviewer receipts.

locks.title: Privacy lock
locks.copy: Do not store personal reflections on a server without consent and export/delete controls.

locks.title: Authority lock
locks.copy: Do not present VedaPath as a guru, therapist, ritual authority, or replacement for tradition.

packet:
VedaPath Private Launch Gate v4.6.0
Private demo: allowed with static source-first prototype labels
Public launch: blocked
Live AI: blocked until source API tests and no-source evals pass
Production storage: blocked until consent, export, deletion, audit, and reviewer accounts exist
Founder next: decide whether to build real Source API test harness or private demo script
